climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state whose wine industry was wiped out by Prohibition. The modern industry focuses on French hybrid and native grapes, which resist the fungal diseases of its humid climate. Most wineries are in Middle and East Tennessee.
